tools.name: brief_preise
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what it costs or how long it takes to send a paper letter or registered mail (Einschreiben) to Germany. Zeigt Preise, Laufzeiten und Einschränkungen für den Versand echter Papierbriefe per Deutscher Post. Read-only.

tools.name: brief_vorbereiten
tools.description: Use this when the user wants something delivered as a real paper letter to a recipient in Germany, for example: cancelling a contract with a German company (gym, mobile phone, internet, insurance, streaming, newspaper, club membership), telling a landlord in writing about a defect such as broken hea

tools.name: brief_status
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether a letter prepared with brief_vorbereiten has been paid, printed or handed to Deutsche Post, or wants its tracking number. Zeigt den Stand eines Briefs. Read-only.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: brief_preise, brief_status · Public sink: brief_preise, brief_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: brief_preise, brief_status · Public sink: brief_preise, brief_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
